integrity: Proof and exact checks supplied; no claim of independent verification or of prior publication of the result.
scientific_limitations: Classification requires equality of the digit sums in the two power-related bases and makes no claim about all simultaneously Niven integers with unequal digit sums. Construction is infinite and explicit but not optimized for small witnesses; novelty may be affected by unindexed literature.
title: A local-to-global residue classification for equal-digit-sum Niven numbers in power-related bases
